events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds - Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court of Spurs' ball was confirmed.
Craig (DEN) makes contact with DeRozan's (SAS) body and affects his driving shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) grabs Poeltl's (SAS) arm during the rebound.
Forber (SAS) briefly engages with Hernangomez (DEN) while going around the screen.
Murray (DEN) makes marginal contact with Aldridge (SAS) while setting the screen.
White (SAS) maintains a legal guarding position on Jokic's (DEN) shot.
Jokic (DEN) and Poeltl (SAS) briefly engage and disengage on the rebound.
Aldridge (SAS) and Jokic (DEN) engage with one another during the loose ball and a held ball is whistled.
Murray (DEN) makes marginal contact with Aldridge (SAS) while setting the screen.
[Observable in enhanced video] Murray (DEN) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Jokic (DEN) makes contact with DeRozan's (SAS) body and affects his driving shot attempt.
After the pick, Aldridge (SAS) makes marginal contact with Murray (DEN) that does not affect his ability to get to the loose ball.
Craig (DEN) makes contact with White's (SAS) body and affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Forbes (SAS) makes contact with Morris' (DEN) body and affects his driving shot attempt.
Forbes (SAS) makes marginal contact with Hernangomez (DEN) while setting the screen.
Plumlee (DEN) intentional kicks the basketball on the play.
